commands_run.command:
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess
s=Path(".planning/phases/86-pilot-reference-record/86-publication-gate.sh").read_text()
a=s.index("awk ")+5
z=s.index(chr(39)+" \"$ev\"",a)
program=s[a:z]
h="a"*64; old="b"*64
for section,disposition in [("Credential-shape hand review","not a credential -- "),("Public-infrastructure hand review","not private infrastructure -- ")]:
 env=dict(os.environ,X="fixture.txt",S=section,H=h,D=disposition)
 header="## "+section+"\n"
 def entry(v,reason="fixture"):
  return "- `fixture.txt` sha256 `"+v+"`: "+disposition+reason+"\n"
 cases=[("current",header+entry(h),0),("stale",header+entry(old),1),("superseded",header+entry(old)+entry(h),0),("pending",header+entry(h)+"- `fixture.txt`: pending hand review\n",1),("duplicate section",header+entry(h)+header,3),("empty reason",header+entry(h,""),1),("other path",header+entry(h).replace("fixture.txt","other.txt"),1)]
 for name,data,want in cases:
  r=subprocess.run(["awk",program],input=data,text=True,env=env,capture_output=True)
  assert r.returncode==want,(section,name,r.returncode,r.stderr)
  print(section,name,r.returncode)
print("14 parser checks passed")'
